This directory contains unmodified occt-import-js 0.0.23 and its OpenCascade WebAssembly dependency.
The library runs as a separate, replaceable browser script/WASM module. To use a modified compatible build, replace occt-import-js.js and occt-import-js.wasm here. Application source is supplied in the surrounding package.
License texts are supplied as license.occt-import-js.txt and license.occt.txt.
Corresponding importer source, build scripts, and the OpenCascade submodule reference:
https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js/tree/0.0.23
https://registry.npmjs.org/occt-import-js/-/occt-import-js-0.0.23.tgz
OpenCascade upstream source:
https://git.dev.opencascade.org/repos/occt.git
